integrity: Proof from eight explicit norm collisions, an exact nonzero integer minor, exhaustive finite-rank calculation, and induction; external independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to positive variables and the coefficient-matched quadratic norm x squared plus four times y squared.
The outer function is characterized only on the set of positively represented integers.
The nonlinear one-function equation was solved by the cited literature, and no priority is asserted for its classification.
A complete review cannot rule out unindexed prior deductions of the exact finite threshold.
title: Sharp ten-coordinate rigidity for a four-weighted quadratic norm equation
